hypothesis.claim: A 9-tap Gaussian can be evaluated with 5 bilinear fetches: each pair of neighbouring taps is fetched once at the weight-weighted position between them, using the hardware's linear filter to do the blend. Same kernel, same weights.
hypothesis.predicted_cost: 9 -> 5 texture fetches; weights still computed in-shader
hypothesis.predicted_error: Sub-code on smooth inputs; up to ~1 code where the 8-bit bilinear weight quantization bites next to bright edges
